title: Update Q values from sampled transitions
description: You follow action selection, the update target, and the recorded episode returns.

steps.description: You configure learning and exploration settings. epsilon_greedy either samples an action or chooses the largest entry in the current Q row.
You initialize Q and reset the environment for each episode. Each step selects an action and samples a next state, reward, and terminal flag.

steps.question: Does the update target include a next-state Q value when done is true?
steps.answer: It uses zero for that part of the target. Otherwise it adds the discounted maximum next-state Q value to the reward.

steps.description: You move Q[s,a] toward the target and accumulate rewards in G. After each episode, eps decays toward its lower bound and G enters returns.
You derive values and greedy actions from Q and plot episode returns with a moving average. The recorded returns still vary after eps reaches its lower bound.
